verdict.rationale: Brex's own AI page says its assistants fetch receipts and offer policy help to employees (brex-docs-23), and that its review agent follows up with anyone out of compliance (brex-docs-16), all based on company policies (brex-docs-41, brex-docs-8). That covers receipt-chasing and general policy guidance, but only through brief marketing claims. Missing for 10: evidence that the assistant explains card declines, explicit pre-spend "can I expense this?" answers, detail on the conversational interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
